acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh disposable TUI run completes install, wizard, benchmark, record, offline replay, and comparison.
Provider, authentication method/API-key reference, agents, models, defaults, and workloads are selectable with clear diagnostics.
Replay runs with network denied and uses only the recorded cassette.
Exact ASB/TUI heads, channel, settings, workloads, and comparison availability are emitted in human and JSON forms.
Missing authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: Disposable TUI acceptance runner passes against exact paired main heads.
Independent review accepts the receipt and recovery matrix.

gates.description: Install-to-comparison journey passes with offline and unavailable-provider negatives.
